tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List Task Projects
tools.description: List task projects accessible to the current user, optionally filtered by space, the most recently modified first. In a run limited to a space, only the projects managed through that space are listed. To find a project by its name, pass name: the projects whose name holds all its words, ignoring case; when none does, those holding any one of them. With managed_only, only the projects the user manages: named among their managers, or a manager of the space that holds the project (with space_id, the projects whose managers hold one of the user's roles of that space); wider than the Tasks app's "I manage" filter, which lists only the projects naming the user. Compact items, without counts; get_project_by_id for details. While has_more, call again with offset=next_offset: a question about every project needs every page, so pass limit 100. Outside a run limited to a space, for the status, the open, overdue or completed tasks of several or all projects, never call a tool once per project: call list_tasks once with group_by project and limit 1.

name.description: Words of the project name: projects holding all of them, ignoring case; when none does, any one of them.

managed_only.description: true: only the projects the user manages. Default false: the projects the user manages or takes part in.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List Tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally filtered by project; without project_id, every task the user can access, personal tasks included. With overdue_only, only the open tasks past their due date, the most overdue first, each with days_overdue. With title, only the tasks whose title contains it, ignoring case. With changed_since, only the tasks whose status, project, due date, assignee or completion changed since that date; with completed_since, only those completed since then; either adds each task's changes (field, old_value, new_value, date, author): use them instead of comparing dates. With assignee, status_id, priority, without_due_date, or due_from and due_to, only the matching tasks: answer a count from count, never by reading pages. To count by board, assignee, status, label or due period, completed tasks with completed_only included, call once with group_by or group_by_project and limit 1, never once per board, person or status, and answer from its counts and summary for this call's filters only. For the tasks or cards with no assignee, in every column, pass unassigned_only, with boards_only across the boards, and answer from its count, with limit 100 to name them; never call get_task_by_id once per task to read assignees. For the open tasks each person carries across the user's boards, call once with group_by assignee, boards_only, hide_completed_tasks and limit 1, never once per project. Compact items (status is the board column); get_task_by_id for details. A commented task carries last_comment_date and last_comment_author; comments_count counts the replies. count is the total. While has_more, call again with offset=next_offset. In a run limited to a space, project_id is required and must be a project of that space, as list_projects returns them. To find a task by words of its title or description, call search_tasks instead of listing a whole project.

include_change_log.description: Full tasks with their change log instead of compact items.

overdue_only.description: Only the open tasks whose due date is before today, in the user's time zone; a task due today is not overdue.

title.description: A part of the task title, matched ignoring case.

changed_since.description: Only the tasks whose status, project, due date, assignee or completion changed at or after this date. A date such as 2026-10-14, read as the start of that day in the user's time zone, or a date and time with its offset such as 2026-10-14T09:00:00+02:00.

completed_since.description: Only the tasks completed at or after this date, whatever hide_completed_tasks says; not together with overdue_only. A date such as 2026-10-14, read as the start of that day in the user's time zone, or a date and time with its offset such as 2026-10-14T09:00:00+02:00.

assignee.description: Only the tasks assigned to this user, by username.

status_id.description: Only the tasks in this status, a status_id of list_project_statuses.

include_description.description: true: each item carries its description as plain text, cut at 500 characters (description_truncated when cut).

without_due_date.description: Only the tasks with no due date; not together with overdue_only, due_from or due_to.

due_from.description: Only the tasks due at or after this date: a date such as 2026-11-09, from the start of that day in the user's time zone, or a date and time with its offset.

due_to.description: Only the tasks due at or before this date: a date such as 2026-11-15, to the end of that day in the user's time zone, or a date and time with its offset.

group_by_project.description: true: also projects, each board's count of the tasks selected, its open_count and overdue_count (its open and overdue tasks, whatever the other filters) and by_status; and project_count and open_project_count (boards holding tasks only), projects_not_listed, personal_count and summary. In a run limited to a space, once per project of that space.

priority.description: Only the tasks of this priority; NONE also selects the tasks with no priority. count then counts those tasks, and with group_by_project so does each board's count.

group_by.description: project: as group_by_project. assignee, status, label or due_period (overdue, this_week, next_week, later, none): groups, each with count and open_count (its open tasks within project_id, managed_only and boards_only), group_count, groups_not_listed past 100, and summary. overdue counts completed tasks too unless hide_completed_tasks. Keys: usernames, status names, label ids. Not with group_by_project true for another grouping.

managed_only.description: true: only the tasks of the boards the user manages, as list_projects managed_only reads them; no personal task. Grouped without project_id, the answer adds managed_project_count (every board the user manages), idle_project_count (those with no open task), overdue_count and overdue_project_count.

completed_only.description: true: only the completed tasks, whatever their completion date. Not with overdue_only, nor with hide_completed_tasks unless completed_since is given.

unassigned_only.description: true: only the tasks with no assignee, whatever their coworkers. Not with assignee.

boards_only.description: true: only the tasks on a board, personal tasks left out, in count and in each group's open_count; with project_id or managed_only it changes nothing.

tools.name: list_project_activity_since
tools.title: Get Project Activity since last days
tools.description: Lists a project's tasks updated in the last days, the most recently active first, each with its changes and comments of the period, then its other uncompleted tasks: at most 20 tasks in all. The period starts at midnight of the user's day, that number of days ago. has_more is true when the project has more such tasks than shown: to list every uncompleted task of the project, page list_tasks with project_id and hide_completed_tasks true. uncompleted_count is the count of the project's uncompleted tasks.

tools.name: list_assigned_tasks
tools.title: Get Self Assigned Tasks
tools.description: List uncompleted tasks assigned to the current user, or of which they are a coworker. With overdue_only, only those past their due date, the most overdue first; an overdue task carries days_overdue. With changed_since, only those whose status, project, due date, assignee or completion changed since that date, completed tasks included; an assignee change of a task created since that date is not counted. With completed_since, only those completed since that date; not together with overdue_only. A task listed with either carries changes: each change since that date, oldest first, with its field, its old_value and new_value when the change log records them, its date and its author. With due_from and due_to, only those due in that range. With priority, only the tasks of that priority: for a question on priority, filter with it and answer from count and the items, never by reading pages for it. Otherwise, the most recently active first. Compact items. Each item carries relation: assignee for a task assigned to the user, coworker for a task the user is only a coworker of; a task the user is both assignee and coworker of is assignee. assigned_count and coworker_count split count the same way. A commented task carries last_comment_date and last_comment_author, its latest comment or reply; comments_count counts the replies. count is the total. While has_more, call again with offset=next_offset.

overdue_only.description: Only the tasks whose due date is before today, in the user's time zone; a task due today is not overdue.

changed_since.description: Only the tasks whose status, project, due date, assignee or completion changed at or after this date. A date such as 2026-10-14, read as the start of that day in the user's time zone, or a date and time with its offset such as 2026-10-14T09:00:00+02:00.

completed_since.description: Only the tasks completed at or after this date. A date such as 2026-10-14, read as the start of that day in the user's time zone, or a date and time with its offset such as 2026-10-14T09:00:00+02:00.

include_description.description: true: each item carries its description as plain text, cut at 500 characters (description_truncated when cut).

due_from.description: Only the tasks due at or after this date: a date such as 2026-11-09, from the start of that day in the user's time zone, or a date and time with its offset.

due_to.description: Only the tasks due at or before this date: a date such as 2026-11-15, to the end of that day in the user's time zone, or a date and time with its offset.

priority.description: Only the tasks of this priority; NONE also selects the tasks with no priority. count then counts those tasks.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.title: Search Tasks
tools.description: Search the tasks the user can view by words of their title or description, ignoring case and accents: every word must be in the title, or every word in the description. A word with a digit, such as 08 or L5, must be a whole word of the title or of the description, 8 matching 08 and never 108; a task id goes to get_task_by_id. Tasks named by their titles are searched one title per call. With project_id, only the tasks of that project. Call it to find a task or a card by its name, before listing a whole project. The open tasks come first, the most relevant first; the completed ones only with include_completed, after the open ones. Each task comes with its task_id, title, link, project, status (its column on the board) and labels; call get_task_by_id for its details. has_more says more tasks may match than were returned: call again with project_id or with more words with letters, since a word with a digit does not narrow the search; a higher limit helps only when the tasks returned fill it.

query.description: The words searched in the title or the description of the tasks; at least one word with letters.

project_id.description: The project whose tasks are searched; none for every task the user can view.

include_completed.description: Whether the completed tasks are returned too, after the open ones.

limit.description: The most tasks returned, 10 by default, 100 at most.
